policy: Dark-only; never reads `hub-theme`, ships no toggle, no `data-theme` attribute anywhere in world.css. Rationale: cinema has no daytime — the projector is the only sun this world acknowledges. Every surface is specced once, in the dark: canvas charcoal rgb(26,28,28), ink bone rgb(249,244,235), all layering by alpha (bone 4–60%, black 40–60% + blur(24px)) per the measured census — no second palette exists to maintain.
typecasting: Two faces, both already self-hosted in site/public/fonts — zero new downloads, declared in world.css @font-face exactly as v1. **General Sans Variable (200–700)** is the SuisseBPIntl stand-in and owns three measured roles: (a) DISPLAY — hero only — 700 / uppercase / lh 0.80 / −0.02em at ~5.7vw capped 7.69rem (the measured Display voice); (b) STATEMENT H1 — section statements — 700 / uppercase / lh 0.80 / −0.02em via the exact measured clamp(2.5rem, 0.9375rem + 3.13vw, 3.75rem); (c) QUIET H2 — 400 / lh 0.90 / NO uppercase at ~3.4vw via clamp(1.75rem, 0.85rem + 2.4vw, 3.25rem); body 400 / lh 1.2 at ~1.5vw via clamp(1rem, 0.6875rem + 0.63vw, 1.25rem). **Sometype Mono Variable (400–700)** — the reference's actual mono — owns every label, chip, timecode, spec row, and annotation at exactly **10px / weight 500 / uppercase / lh 1.8 / fixed at every breakpoint** (the measured `ll-add-tag` role; natively tabular, so the 24fps timecode never jitter-resizes). Global letter-spacing −0.02em on every role — one knob, per the anatomy. No third face, ever; hierarchy comes from weight + alpha + scale, not new families.

downloads.name: Sometype Mono Variable — already self-hosted at site/public/fonts/SometypeMono-Variable.woff2 (16KB, no new fetch)
General Sans Variable — already self-hosted at site/public/fonts/GeneralSans-Variable.woff2 (no new fetch)

sections.name: S1 — DRIVE (entrance, 100dvh)
sections.spec:
Keep the verified v1 night-drive rig (site/src/worlds/01-noir/scene.ts) as the fixed full-viewport compositor; the page now scrolls past it (remove `overflow:hidden` from body — v1 world.css line 30). Hero section itself is transparent over the canvas; S2–S5 carry solid `background: var(--canvas)` at z-index 1 and slide over the scene.

**Layout**: fixed chrome at the measured 16px viewport insets, z-index 2. Top-left chip `[ 01 — NOIR ]` (bone-10% + backdrop-blur(24px), radius 4px, mono role, padding 11px 24px 11px 12px — v1 chip geometry kept). Top-right roll-link chip `BACK TO HUB` (black-60% + blur(24px)) with the v1 duplicated-text roll-over. Statement block bottom-left inside the 40px page margin on the 12-col / 24px-gutter grid, no max-width.

**Copy** — H1 DISPLAY role (General Sans 700, uppercase, lh 0.80, −0.02em, `clamp(3rem, 5.7vw, 7.69rem)` — the measured Display scale):
`THE LIGHTS` / `STAY LOW.`
Sub (body role, opacity 0.75, max-width 30rem):
`A night drive, rendered live. Two colors — and whatever the headlights admit.`
Bottom chrome chips: `[ CHARCOAL & BONE ]` · `[ SCROLL FOR THE REEL ]` with a hand-drawn 10×14 down-arrow SVG (1.25px bone stroke, square caps) that draws on via stroke-dashoffset (0.65s power4.out), then loops a 6px y-drift (GSAP, 2.4s sine.inOut yoyo).

**Motion** (v1 entrance verified — keep exactly): words yPercent 110→0, 0.65s expo.out, stagger 0.08, start 0.15s; sub autoAlpha+y14, 0.65s at 0.5s; chips y −10, 0.45s, stagger 0.06 at 0.35s. Scroll response (ScrollTrigger, hero as trigger, scrub 0.6, first viewport only): camera.position.y 1.35→1.9 and lookAt y 1.0→0.6 — a slow crane pull-up, the road recedes as S2's solid charcoal slides over. Scene ticking gated by IntersectionObserver on the hero; pointer parallax (x ±0.22, lookAt ±0.6) active only while hero intersects.

sections.name: S2 — DOGMA (the rules index, ~90vh)
sections.spec:
**Layout**: 12-col, 40px margin, 24px gutter; section padding-block `max(120px, 8.33vw)` (the measured vw-token formula, 120/1440), zero margin between sections. Solid charcoal background. Left rail (cols 1–3): mono chip `[ THE DOGMA ]`. Right (cols 4–12): quiet H2 then four hairline rows.

**H2** (quiet counter-voice: General Sans 400, lh 0.90, no uppercase, `clamp(1.75rem, 0.85rem + 2.4vw, 3.25rem)`):
`Noir is a discipline, not a mood.`

**Rows** — each: 1px top hairline bone-10%; grid = mono number left (col 4) / statement middle (cols 5–9) / mono annotation right (cols 10–12, right-aligned); padding-block 28px:
`[ 01 ]` — `Two colors. Commitment is the third.` — `[ RGB 26,28,28 / 249,244,235 ]`
`[ 02 ]` — `Red is footage, never paint.` — `[ SEE REEL 01 ]`
`[ 03 ]` — `Light is the only decoration.` — `[ EMISSIVE VS DARK ]`
`[ 04 ]` — `Nothing moves without a motive.` — `[ 0.65S, POWER4.OUT ]`
Statement text: General Sans 400, `clamp(1.25rem, 0.9rem + 1.1vw, 1.875rem)`, lh 1.1. Rows are duplicated-text roll-overs (the measured pattern: two stacked copies in an overflow-hidden wrapper, both translateY −100%, 0.45s expo.out, reversed on leave) + row background tweened to bone-4% via GSAP backgroundColor 0.35s (never a CSS transition).

**Reveal** (ScrollTrigger start `top 75%`, once:true): hairlines scaleX 0→1, transform-origin left, 0.65s power4.out, stagger 0.12; row words masked line-rise (yPercent 110→0, 0.65s expo.out, stagger 0.03 within row); annotations autoAlpha 0.35s at +0.2s.

sections.name: S3 — REEL 01 (red as footage — the signature, ~110vh)
sections.spec:
The one place red exists on this page, imprisoned in a frame. **No `--red` token exists in world.css — red lives only inside GLSL/2D-canvas pixels.**

**Layout**: above the card (cols 3–11), statement `THE ONLY RED IN TOWN.` in the STATEMENT H1 role — the exact measured `clamp(2.5rem, 0.9375rem + 3.13vw, 3.75rem)`. Media card spans cols 3–11, aspect 16:9, radius 4px, border 1px bone-12%, background `#141010` (letterbox ground, visible only under fallback stills), overflow hidden. Four hand-drawn corner-bracket SVGs (12×12, 1.25px bone stroke, 8px inside each corner) sit OVER the footage — film-frame registration marks. Below the card (cols 3–7), body copy: `Ink, shot on shader. Domain-warped fbm at twenty-four frames a second — the one frame where color is allowed to exist.`

**In-frame chrome** (all bone, all mono 10px): top-left chip `[ REEL 01 — INK, LIVE ]` (black-60% + blur(24px), 12px inset); bottom-left live timecode `TC 00:00:00:00` incrementing at 24fps — frames = Scene B rendered-frame count mod 24, counting only while the card intersects and the loop runs (Sometype Mono is natively tabular: zero layout jitter); bottom-right `[ 1.85:1 ]`. Cue-mark idle event: drawn 8px circle glyph top-right blinks twice (opacity 0→1→0, 0.12s each) every 20–40s, intervals drawn from a mulberry32(0x0C1E) stream — the reel-change dot.

**Shader**: the exact fbm recipe in assets2d. Rendered by the shared one-context compositor into the card's scissor rect; rect synced via getBoundingClientRect **per frame while the card intersects** (native scroll moves it every frame), cached only while hidden. The card's own background stays transparent in WebGL mode so the canvas shows through; the ≤4px rounded-corner overshoot of the square canvas rect is invisible against the footage's own dark edges and the 1px border.

**Interaction**: pointer-x over the card tweens uniform `uGain` 1.0→1.6 (GSAP on the uniform object, 0.65s power4.out) — the ink billows harder under the cursor; leave reverses. The card itself never transforms on hover — the footage reacts, the frame never does.

**Reveal** (ScrollTrigger start `top 75%`, once): card clip-path `inset(8% 4% 8% 4%)`→`inset(0%)` + inner content y 6%→0, **0.65s power4.out** (the measured workhorse — nothing on this page exceeds the 0.35–0.65s census); timecode starts counting only when revealed.

sections.name: S4 — SPECIMEN (proof of discipline, ~90vh)
sections.spec:
The lab-exhibit section: the world displays its own measured anatomy as content.

**Layout**: quiet H2 `Every number in this room was measured, not felt.` Then two columns. LEFT (cols 1–6): spec sheet — mono 10px rows, key left / value right, 1px bone-8% hairlines, padding-block 14px, lh 1.8:
`CANVAS — RGB(26,28,28)` / `INK — RGB(249,244,235)` / `LAYERING — ALPHA ONLY` / `RADIUS — 4PX, NEVER MORE` / `INSET — 16PX` / `GRID — 12 COL · 40PX · 24PX` / `STATEMENT — 700 · UPPERCASE · LH 0.80` / `LABEL — SOMETYPE MONO 10PX FIXED` / `EASE — POWER4.OUT × EXPO.OUT` / `WORKHORSE — 0.65S` / `RED — FOOTAGE ONLY`.
RIGHT (cols 8–12): the alpha ladder — five stacked chips, exactly **168×50** (the measured timeline-chip geometry), radius 4px, backdrop-blur(24px), backgrounds bone at 4 / 10 / 20 / 40 / 60%, each captioned inside `[ BONE 04% ]` … `[ BONE 60% ]`; a sixth chip solid bone with charcoal text `[ ACTIVE ]` (the measured active/idle chip states, exhibited as specimens). Under the ladder, a weight stack: `NOIR` ×3 at General Sans 700 / 500 / 300, uppercase, lh 0.80, `clamp(2rem, 1.4rem + 1.2vw, 3rem)`, opacities 100 / 60 / 30% — one face, three weights, alpha doing the rest.

**Reveal** (ScrollTrigger start `top 75%`, once): spec rows hairline scaleX + text line-rise (same S2 vocabulary, stagger 0.06); ladder chips y 24→0 + autoAlpha, 0.45s expo.out, stagger 0.07; weight-stack words line-rise stagger 0.08.

sections.name: S5 — EXIT (handoff, 100dvh)
sections.spec:
Full-viewport close, statement centered on the lower third like a title card. Solid charcoal background.

**Rotating statement** (STATEMENT H1 role, measured clamp): strings swap every 6s — out: words yPercent −110 behind the line masks, 0.45s **expo.out** (the pole's census contains only .out eases; the clip mask supplies the exit read), stagger 0.05 — then in: yPercent 110→0, 0.65s expo.out, stagger 0.08. Strings:
`LEAVE THE LIGHTS ON.` → `SAME TIME TOMORROW NIGHT.` → `THE REEL NEVER ENDS.`
(voice-as-design, our version of the reference's rotating header strings; static first string under prefers-reduced-motion.)

**Handoff chips** (row under the statement, 12px gap, both duplicated-text roll-overs 0.45s expo.out): `BACK TO HUB` (black-60% + blur(24px)) and `NEXT — 02 CHROME` (bone-10% + blur(24px)) with the drawn 10×14 right-arrow glyph (1.25px stroke) that nudges x+4 via GSAP 0.45s expo.out on hover. Bottom chrome at 16px insets: `[ WORLD 01 — NOIR ]` · `[ EST. 2026 ]`.

**Wayfinding rail** (page-level, specced here once): fixed left 16px, vertically centered, z-index 2, visible ≥1200px only; five chips 168×50 stacked with 8px gaps, mono 10px — `[ 01 DRIVE ]` `[ 02 DOGMA ]` `[ 03 REEL ]` `[ 04 SPECIMEN ]` `[ 05 EXIT ]`; idle bone-10% + blur(24px), active solid bone with charcoal text (the measured active/idle states); click = GSAP ScrollToPlugin, 0.9s power4.inOut (programmatic scroll — the one motion exempt from the 0.35–0.65s element census, Lenis territory on the pole); active state driven by ScrollTrigger section spans (start `top center`, end `bottom center`). Rail enters once at load: x −12 + autoAlpha, 0.45s expo.out, stagger 0.05, at 0.6s.

**Mobile rule (page-level)**: below 900px the 12-col grid collapses to a single stack at 20px page margin (v1's breakpoint), rail hidden, reel card spans full width, all type keeps its vw clamps (fluid by construction); mono labels stay 10px fixed, per the anatomy.

centerpiece: ONE fixed full-viewport canvas (z-index 0), ONE WebGLRenderer compositing two scenes via scissor rects — lamalama composites its whole page in WebGL across 3 canvases; we do it with a single context (the dev machine exhausts contexts, and two canvases double the loss risk). Renderer: antialias on, dpr min(devicePixelRatio, 1.75), ACESFilmicToneMapping, exposure 1.1, autoClear false, setScissorTest(true), setClearColor(charcoal 0x1a1c1c, 1) — the opaque charcoal clear is identical to the page background, so unscissored regions are seamless. Per frame: full-canvas clear; (a) if hero intersects — setViewport/scissor to the hero's visible region and render Scene A; (b) if the reel card intersects — sync scissor+viewport to the card's getBoundingClientRect (read per frame while visible) and render Scene B. Neither visible → cancelAnimationFrame entirely; either IntersectionObserver entry restarts the loop; hidden tab → cancelAnimationFrame (v1 pattern kept). SCENE A (night drive, verified v1, evolved): charcoal Fog(6→60), road plane + 2 shoulder strips, InstancedMesh lane dashes (24) + posts (14) + lamps (14) recycling at 9 m/s, oncoming car as 2 additive canvas-glow sprites on a **mulberry32(0x01C4A)-seeded 4–9s cycle** (replaces v1's Math.random — cache-stable per the hard rule), bone moon directional 0.32 + grazing fill 0.14 + ambient 0.05, no shadows; camera-only sway + pointer parallax (x ±0.22, lookAt ±0.6) + the new scroll crane (y 1.35→1.9, lookAt y 1.0→0.6, scrub 0.6 over the first viewport). Draw calls: road 1 + shoulders 2 + dashes 1 + posts 1 + lamps 1 + sprites 2 = 8. SCENE B (reel 01): one fullscreen triangle, one ShaderMaterial (fbm ink recipe in assets2d), ortho camera — 1 draw call; ~25 value-noise octave evaluations per pixel, trivial for any real GPU at the card's ~900×506 rect × dpr 1.75. TOTAL: 9 draw calls, ≤40 budget respected 4×; texture memory = one 64×64 canvas glow texture, nothing else. Interactions: pointer parallax (A, gated to hero visibility), uGain scrub tween on card hover (B), timecode driven from B's rendered-frame counter. webglcontextlost: preventDefault, canvas visibility hidden (the fixed .scene div stays var(--canvas) charcoal — zero white flash), timecode freezes at its last value; restored: canvas visible, repaint/resume. Software renderer (SwiftShader/llvmpipe detect via WEBGL_debug_renderer_info, kept from v1): dpr 1, Scene A renders ONE composed frame to the fixed canvas (car mid-distance at carT 4.5, sway t 2.5) and the loop never starts; Scene B does NOT render to the compositor at all — the reel card instead shows the 2D-canvas ink twin inside its own DOM (identical fbm math, drawn once), because a fixed-canvas still cannot track a scrolling card.
assets2d: Three families, all generated from what we own, all seeded — nothing downloaded, nothing stock. (1) THE INK FOOTAGE (signature): GLSL fragment shader, highp; iq-style integer hash offset by uSeed derived once from mulberry32(0x01F1) — cache-stable, never Math.random; value-noise fbm, 5 octaves, lacunarity 2.0, gain 0.5; two-level domain warp: q = vec2(fbm(p), fbm(p+vec2(5.2,1.3))); r = vec2(fbm(p + 4.0·q + vec2(1.7,9.2) + 0.05·uTime), fbm(p + 4.0·q + vec2(8.3,2.8) + 0.04·uTime)); f = fbm(p + uGain·4.0·r) with base drift p += uTime·0.03 — ink drifts, never boils. Color ramp (4 stops, smoothstepped): #0B0304 → #3D080C @0.35 → #8F1216 @0.62 → #E75D60 @0.88 — highlights land exactly on the reference's measured signal red rgb(231,93,96), inside the frame only. Density shaping f = f·f·(3−2f); vignette ×(1 − 0.35·dot(uv−.5,uv−.5)·2.2); in-frame grain + (hash(fragCoord+uTime)−0.5)·(3.0/255) — grain lives INSIDE the footage; the page stays clean two-color. (2) STILL-FRAME TWIN: the same fbm + ramp re-implemented in JS on a 2D canvas (512×288, same mulberry32 seed, drawn once via requestIdleCallback after the entrance — ~3.7M noise evaluations, one-time, off the critical path); mounted inside the reel card's DOM so it scrolls naturally. Identical math means the still IS a frame of the footage, not a lookalike. (3) DRAWN GLYPH SET (Noir's 10px-mono-grade hairline language, per the icons-are-drawn rule — no Lucide, nothing downloaded): corner brackets 12×12, down/right arrows 10×14, cue-mark circle r4, registration crosshair 12×12 — all 1.25px bone stroke, square caps, inline SVG; entrances animate stroke-dashoffset draw-on (0.65s power4.out); idles are GSAP micro-loops (arrow y-drift 6px 2.4s sine.inOut; cue-mark double-blink on the seeded 20–40s clock).
motion: GSAP owns every element transform — zero CSS transitions on transform/opacity anywhere (the measured pole has zero CSS hover transitions; hub v1 already paid for breaking this). EASE VOCABULARY (the measured census: power4.out ×62, expo.out ×58, nothing else): expo.out for text/micro (word rises, roll-overs, chips, rotating-statement exits AND entrances), power4.out for structural (hairlines, card clip-path, uniform tweens), power4.inOut only for programmatic scroll-to. No .in eases exist on the pole — exits read through the clip masks. DURATIONS: 0.65s workhorse (all reveals, the card clip, uniform tweens), 0.45s roll-overs/chips/statement-exits, 0.35s micro-fades — element motion never leaves the measured 0.35–0.65s census; the single exemption is ScrollToPlugin at 0.9s (programmatic scroll, not element motion). STAGGERS: 0.08 word, 0.06 chip, 0.12 row-hairline, 0.03 word-in-row, 0.05 rail/exit-out. ENTRANCE (hero, verified v1): words yPercent 110→0 expo.out 0.65s stagger 0.08 @0.15 → chips @0.35 → sub @0.5. SCROLL REVEALS: ScrollTrigger start 'top 75%', once:true; hairlines scaleX 0→1 origin-left; text is always the masked word-rise (yPercent 110→0 inside overflow-hidden line wrappers), never opacity-only. HOVER: duplicated-text roll-over exclusively — two stacked copies, both translateY −100%, 0.45s expo.out, reversed on leave; row backgrounds tween via GSAP backgroundColor 0.35s; the footage card hover tweens uGain (shader reacts, frame never transforms). IDLE (the world breathes on the 24-frame clock): timecode at 24fps while the reel intersects; car pass every 4–9s (mulberry32-seeded); cue-mark double-blink every 20–40s (seeded); exit statement rotates every 6s; scroll-arrow drift 6px 2.4s sine.inOut. prefers-reduced-motion: entrances become 0.3s autoAlpha, rotation/idle loops off, both scenes take the still-frame path.
fallback: Ladder, top down. (1) LIVE: full rig, 9 draw calls, dpr ≤1.75, both scenes in one context. (2) STILL FRAMES (software renderer detected via WEBGL_debug_renderer_info, or prefers-reduced-motion): dpr 1; Scene A renders ONE composed WebGL frame to the fixed canvas (car mid-distance at carT 4.5, sway t 2.5 — a genuine film still; fresh-context render verified on this machine in v1) and the loop never starts; the reel card shows the seeded 2D-canvas ink twin INSIDE its DOM (identical math — a real frame of the footage, and it scrolls with the card, which a fixed-canvas still cannot do); timecode displays a frozen `TC 00:00:02:00` caption (the still's uTime 2.0, honest labeling). (3) NO WEBGL / CONTEXT NEVER RESTORES: canvas hidden, art-directed DOM fallback, in-voice, no decorative gradient blobs: HERO becomes a title-card composition — charcoal ground, 1px bone-15% horizon hairline at 62%, road as a clip-path trapezoid (polygon(38% 62%, 62% 62%, 78% 100%, 22% 100%)) in #232626, a center column of 4 bone dash rectangles stepping opacity 90/60/35/15% toward the horizon, one pair of small radial-gradient headlight glows at 24% alpha sitting ON the horizon line (a rendered light source in-fiction, not a decorative blob — the Sundial-fallback lesson applied); REEL CARD falls back to the 2D-canvas ink still, and if even 2D canvas fails, flat #140607 with the mono caption `[ FOOTAGE UNAVAILABLE — REEL 01 ]` — itself in-voice; every other section is pure DOM and degrades to nothing. CONTEXT-LOST GUARD (runtime, any rung): the fixed .scene div is painted var(--canvas) charcoal; on webglcontextlost → preventDefault + canvas visibility:hidden (charcoal shows through, zero white flash) + timecode freeze; on restored → visible + repaint the still or resume the loop.
distinct: Noir is the only dark world and the only two-color world: charcoal rgb(26,28,28) + bone rgb(249,244,235) with every layer built from alpha, versus the hub's warm cream paper, toy-box solid cards and painted-wood Sundial poster, Chrome's warm-stone greige with serif display and live liquid metal, Monument's gallery-white void with one colossal condensed face and hairline slices, and Pulse's saturated red-as-canvas poster. Its type grammar is unmistakable at a glance — 10px fixed Sometype Mono `[ bracketed ]` labels against 700-weight uppercase statements crushed to lh 0.80 — and its red discipline is the inverse of Pulse's: where Pulse paints the whole room red, Noir locks red inside a single 16:9 footage frame with corner registration brackets and a running 24fps timecode, generated live by a seeded domain-warped fbm ink shader whose highlights are the pole's measured signal red. No other page in the lab has floating blur-chip chrome at 16px insets, a 4px-radius-everywhere rule, duplicated-text roll-overs on every interactive line, a left-rail 168×50 chip timeline, or a one-context WebGL compositor scissoring a night drive and a live ink reel through the same canvas. It reads as a film set after wrap; everything else in the lab reads as daylight.
